第十三章 五品剑
“剑具类型：巨剑，剑名：巨崛。质地：精品，附加属性：力量+4、敏捷+4，极小几率爆击，翻倍攻击。”
“爆击这种东西也有？”叶石笑得合不拢嘴，属性加成这么多，已经让叶石很满意了，而最后的爆击产生翻倍攻击，对叶石而言就是一个惊喜。
哪怕是极小几率，估计一百下下来都不一定能出现一个，但这却给了叶石一个启示。那就是游戏中的给剑具上加持技能，似乎也能应用在这里。
“不枉我加入风行石和大地熊骨髓，果然没人我失望。”叶石挥动着巨崛剑，感觉着这重量压根不是巨剑该有的，但力量却是十足。
这是风行石在起作为，风行石的效果就是增添敏捷，首先要减弱的，就是持剑者拿剑的重量，因此哪怕巨崛剑事实上重量十足，但叶石却感觉不到。
而这仅仅只是针对使用者，作为对手可不会那么好运，风行石对其不起作用不说，大地熊骨髓更是让巨崛剑的力量添加许多，一剑下去是以前无法比拟的。如果倒霉的遇见爆击，那更是一个噩梦。
“提示店主，店铺外来人。”店铺系统发出提醒。
“呃，是谁？”叶石脸色一愣，询问之后才想起店铺系统会提醒有人过来，但对于是谁可说不出来。
“不管是谁，也要出去看看。”叶石放下锤子，离开炼房走向前堂，
“大哥。”张羊尴尬的一笑，眼神里也尽是歉意。
叶石顿了一顿，这才看向张羊旁边的两人，这两人尽管是和张羊站在一起，但脚步却都超出张羊半步，显然地位上而言，这两人都要超出张羊的。
“大人物！”叶石立刻明悟过来，能够站在张羊前面，并且让张羊露出这样表情的，一定是张家某位大人物。
这和那些年轻的世家子弟不同，老一辈的人可不容易忽悠，不过如果能够忽悠成功，一个远超十几个年轻世家子弟。
“两位是？”叶石咳嗽一声，很有礼貌的询问。
“张涛，张羊的父亲。”张涛应了一声，便没有了下文。
“不会是上门讨债的吧？”叶石心下一惊，以为是自己忽悠的情况被张涛知晓，所以来为张羊出头了。但这么一想，又觉得不对，看张羊的模样尽管是遇见什么麻烦事，但应该不是那么严重才是。
“少家主好。”叶石打起招呼，尽管对方的年纪用‘少’有些怪，但毕竟张家的家主是张羊的爷爷，也就是张涛的父亲，所以张涛确实是一位少家主。
张涛点了点头，却是先介绍起旁边的王海，“这位是我张家的客卿，铸剑大师王海。”
叶石看向王海，张涛没有开口却先介绍王海的举动，就让叶石明白王海在张家的地位。对于这铸剑师多如狗的世界，能够受人如此尊敬的，一定是有本事的铸剑师，哪怕叶石也不会小视。

“王大师。”叶石微微行了个礼，当然这是做做样子的，见张涛这么重视王海，如果自己没有什么表示，恐怕会引来一定的麻烦。
最起码的，张羊就不会好受，对于自己这个小弟，浪费金币的事叶石肯定不会，但至少行一个礼，却是无伤大雅。
说叶石没有骨气？穿越前的叶石生活在地球这个现实的年代，就得学会弯腰，尤其是叶石这种在社会底层挣扎的人，所以叶石才会是个财迷。
“嗯。”王海点了点头，对于叶石‘尊敬’之举感到很满意，心里对叶石的非议也因此减弱半分，看来眼前这小子也不是一个只懂夸夸其口的狂妄之辈。
没错，王海对叶石本来的印象，就是一个狂妄之辈，区区一个年轻没有经过岁月积累的铸剑师，竟然说自己打造出的剑能够劈裂四品剑，不是一个狂妄之辈是什么，也就只有张羊这傻乎乎的大个会相信。
其实惊鸿剑和四品剑比较的事情，是当初在场二十几个世家子弟一起看到的，张羊只是其中之一。但张羊口才不行，说的那样精彩，却忽略了说这是自己和其他人亲眼所见，让张涛和王海以为张羊只是听说，这才对叶石印象有些恶劣。
还真别说，凭借张羊对叶石的崇拜，叶石忽悠什么张羊估计都会信。只是这件劈裂四品剑的事情叶石没有忽悠罢了，当然张涛和王海是不知道。
“小兄弟，听说你要给张羊的剑加工，不知道完成了没有。”王海问道。
这时候王海没有按照原本的想法立刻拆穿，他要先让对方把剑拿出来，再以事实据理力争，让对方认识错误，以后不敢在放口狂言。
“大哥。”张羊小声的喊着，使劲的向叶石打眼色，尽管他相信大哥，但这种毫无准备之下难免大哥吃亏，所以他有必要提醒。
“呃。”叶石看了下张羊，见他猛打眼色，又看了下张涛点头的模样，最后看看王海。顿时，叶石摸了摸鼻子，他是明白过来了。
张羊被他忽悠的找不着北，但这两位大佬却不相信，这会找上门来，恐怕打得就是戳爆他的企图。来者不善啊，叶石暗笑一声，要说巨崛剑还是之前的那样，叶石还有些担心这入不了他们的眼，但现在不同了。
“真是巧，我刚刚加工完你们就来了，先进来吧，我马上拿给你们看。”叶石让开一条路，做出了一个‘请’的姿势。
张涛和王海也不客气，走了进去，显然对于叶石的态度比较满意，也不想让他在大庭广众下丢脸，也罢，只要在张羊面前拆穿他就行了。
张羊进去之时想和叶石说些什么，但见到张涛看了过来，只能将话吞回肚子里，再次向叶石打起眼色。
结果当然是换来叶石一阵鄙视，你打眼色就好吧，瞪那么大的眼谁不知道，不知道打眼色就应该隐晦的吗，再有始终都是睁那么大的眼，谁知道你是什么意思，还好我聪明，自己想通了前后关系。
这时叶石也不开口，回到炼房将巨崛剑拿了出来，事实胜于雄辩，说再多还不如把剑拿出来亮亮。
看着巨崛剑的身段，王海又是一阵摇头，就连张涛也明显可以看出目光里的轻视，叶石也不计较，将其拿到了王海的面前，道：“王大师请。”
没错，找个行家看剑，更能体现他剑的不俗。叶石就不相信了，惊鸿剑都能劈裂四品剑，这已经比惊鸿剑超出一大段的巨崛剑会不行。
果然，原本有些轻视的王海接过剑后，目光中露出几分疑惑，就是这剑应该很重才对，怎么这么轻，难道里面是空心的，但那样把剑铸造成这样不就一点意义都没有。但是接下来，王海在看下去后，眼神却是微微露出惊讶。

毕竟是行家，很快便看出一些门道，然而越是看下去，王海就越是心惊，最后王海更是瞪大眼睛站了起来，一脸不信的叫道：“五品剑，竟然会是五品剑！”

Chapter 13 Fifth Grade Sword
"Sword type: Giant Sword, Sword Name: Jurise. Texture: Fine, additional attributes: Strength +4, Agility +4, very small chance of critical hit, double attack."
"Is there such a thing as a critical hit?" Ye Shi smiled from ear to ear. With so many attribute bonuses, Ye Shi was already very satisfied. The last critical hit doubled the attack, which was a surprise for Ye Shi.
Even if it is a very small chance, it is estimated that one may not appear in a hundred times, but this gave Ye Shi a revelation. That is the sword-blessing skill in the game, and it seems that it can also be applied here.
"It's not in vain that I added Fengxing Stone and Earth Bear Marrow. I'm really disappointed." Ye Shi waved the Giant Sword, feeling that the weight was not what a giant sword should have, but it was full of power.
This is the work of the Wind Stone. The effect of the Wind Stone is to increase agility. The first thing that needs to be weakened is the weight of the sword held by the sword holder. Therefore, even though the Giant Sword is actually quite heavy, Ye Shi cannot feel it.
And this is only for the user. As an opponent, you will not be so lucky. Not to mention that the Fengxing Stone has no effect on it, the Earth Bear Bone Marrow adds a lot of power to the Giant Sword. One sword strike is unmatched before. If you are unlucky enough to encounter a critical hit, it will be even more of a nightmare.
"Alert the store owner, there is an outsider in the store." The store system issued a reminder.
"Uh, who is it?" Ye Shi was stunned. After asking, he remembered that the store system would remind someone to come, but he couldn't tell who it was.
"No matter who it is, you should go out and take a look." Ye Shi put down the hammer, left the refining room and walked towards the front hall.
"Brother." Zhang Yang smiled awkwardly, his eyes full of apology.
Ye Shi paused for a moment, then looked at the two people next to Zhang Yang. Although these two people were standing with Zhang Yang, they were half a step ahead of Zhang Yang. Obviously, in terms of status, these two people were ahead of Zhang Yang.
"Big shot!" Ye Shi immediately realized that the person who could stand in front of Zhang Yang and make Zhang Yang look like this must be a big shot in the Zhang family.
This is different from those young children of aristocratic families. People of the older generation are not easy to fool, but if they can be successfully fooled, one person is far better than a dozen young people from aristocratic families.
"Who are you two?" Ye Shi coughed and asked politely.
"Zhang Tao, Zhang Yang's father." Zhang Tao responded and said nothing further.
"It's not like he's coming to collect debts, right?" Ye Shi was startled, thinking that Zhang Tao knew about his deception, so he came to stand up for Zhang Yang. But when I thought about it, I felt something was wrong. Although Zhang Yang looked like he was in trouble, it shouldn't be that serious.
"Hello, young master." Ye Shi greeted. Although it was a bit strange to use "young" for the other person's age, after all, the head of the Zhang family was Zhang Yang's grandfather, Zhang Tao's father, so Zhang Tao was indeed a young master.
Zhang Tao nodded, but first introduced Wang Hai next to him, "This is my Zhang family's guest, the master swordsmith Wang Hai."
Ye Shi looked at Wang Hai. Zhang Tao did not speak but first introduced Wang Hai's actions, letting Ye Shi understand Wang Hai's status in the Zhang family. In this world where there are as many swordsmiths as dogs, the one who can be so respected must be a capable swordsmith, and even Ye Shi will not look down upon him.
"Master Wang." Ye Shi gave a slight salute. Of course, it was just for show. Seeing that Zhang Tao valued Wang Hai so much, if he didn't express anything, he might cause some trouble.
At the very least, Zhang Yang would not feel comfortable. Ye Shi would definitely not waste gold coins on his younger brother, but at least a salute would be harmless.
Say Ye Shi has no backbone? Before Ye Shi traveled through time, he had to learn to bend down when he was living in this realistic era on earth, especially for people like Ye Shi who were struggling at the bottom of society, so Ye Shi was a money addict.
"Yeah." Wang Hai nodded and said to Ye Shi's respectHe was very satisfied with the gesture of respect, and the criticism of Ye Shi in his heart was weakened by half. It seemed that the boy in front of him was not an arrogant person who only knew how to boast.
That's right, Wang Hai's original impression of Ye Shi was that of an arrogant person. A mere young swordsmith with no experience in years of experience actually said that the sword he made could split fourth-grade swords. He was nothing but an arrogant person. Only a stupid big man like Zhang Yang would believe it.
In fact, the comparison between the Jinghong Sword and the Fourth-Rank Sword was witnessed by more than 20 disciples of aristocratic families who were present, and Zhang Yang was just one of them. But Zhang Yang was not good at eloquence. He spoke so wonderfully, but neglected to say that he and others had seen it with their own eyes, which made Zhang Tao and Wang Hai think that Zhang Yang had just heard about it, so they had a bad impression of Ye Shi.
Not to mention, with Zhang Yang's admiration for Ye Shi, Zhang Yang would probably believe whatever Ye Shi tried to fool him. It's just that Ye Shi didn't lie about splitting the fourth-grade sword. Of course, Zhang Tao and Wang Hai didn't know about it.
"Little brother, I heard that you are going to process Zhang Yang's sword. I wonder if it has been completed." Wang Hai asked.
At this time, Wang Hai did not expose it immediately as he originally thought. He wanted to let the other party take out the sword first, and then argue with the facts to make the other party realize their mistake and not dare to talk nonsense in the future.
"Brother." Zhang Yang shouted in a low voice and winked at Ye Shi. Although he believed in his elder brother, he would inevitably suffer from such unpreparedness, so he had to remind him.
"Uh." Ye Shi looked at Zhang Yang and saw his fierce wink, then looked at Zhang Tao's nodding look, and finally looked at Wang Hai. Suddenly, Ye Shi touched his nose and understood.
Zhang Yang was confused by his deception, but the two big guys didn't believe that they would come to him, and they were probably trying to expose him. The person who came here is not a good person. Ye Shi secretly laughed. To say that the Giant Sword was still the same as before, Ye Shi was still a little worried that it would not catch their eyes, but it was different now.
"What a coincidence. I just finished processing and you guys came here. Come in first and I'll show it to you right away." Ye Shi stepped out of the way and made a 'please' gesture.
Zhang Tao and Wang Hai were not polite and walked in. They were obviously satisfied with Ye Shi's attitude and didn't want to embarrass him in public. They just wanted to expose him in front of Zhang Yang.
Zhang Yang wanted to say something to Ye Shi when he entered, but when Zhang Tao looked over, he could only swallow his words back and wink at Ye Shi again.
Of course, the result was Ye Shi's contempt. Just wink. Who doesn't know that with such big eyes, you don't know that a wink should be subtle. Besides, you always keep such wide eyes open. Who knows what you mean. Fortunately, I am smart and figured out the relationship myself.
Ye Shi didn't say anything at this time. He returned to the refining room and took out the Giant Sword. Facts speak louder than words. No matter how much you say, it's better to take out the sword and shine it.
Looking at the figure of Jujujian, Wang Hai shook his head again. Even Zhang Tao could clearly see the contempt in his eyes. Ye Shi didn't care and brought it in front of Wang Hai and said: "Master Wang, please."
That's right, finding an expert to look at the sword can better reflect the quality of his sword. Ye Shi didn't believe it. The Jinghong Sword could split fourth-grade swords. How could the Juriseng Sword, which was already a long way ahead of the Jinghong Sword, not be able to split it?
Sure enough, after Wang Hai, who was a little contemptuous at first, took the sword, his eyes showed some doubts, that is, this sword should be very heavy, why is it so light? Is it hollow inside, but there is no point in casting the sword like this. But then, after Wang Hai continued to look, his eyes showed slight surprise.
After all, he was an expert, so he quickly saw some tricks. However, the more he looked at it, the more frightened Wang Hai became. Finally, Wang Hai stood up with his eyes wide open, and shouted with disbelief: "A fifth-grade sword, it turned out to be a fifth-grade sword!"
